actions.description: Authorise a PC project because independent suppliers, including Logix, Tandy and Apple, are establishing business applications, interfaces and retail/service channels outside IBM. Do not assume a Logix–Apple duopoly. Initially expect external software to shorten development.

outcomes.description: DRI remains an independent licensor but its existing funded development and CP/M-80 commitments leave no committed x86 OS on IBM’s required schedule. Paterson’s recruitment removes the historical SCP 86-DOS route; Letwin’s absence reduces Microsoft staffing options. Alternatives remain possible. Supplier selection, substitute OS development and application qualification become the critical path toward early 1982, rather than technical impossibility.
